WreckItRalph_Ursula/Ursula_VLG_Ralp_010_.en: Why, angelfish, the broth looks perfect!
What's this potion REALLY?
Maybe it's because I did all the work.
Always glad to help you out, Ursula!
Just a little something I'm working on with Valley ingredients.
No tricks, I promise. Why, I'm not even crossing any of my tentacles.
This will put me back in the good books of the other Villagers. It's hard to make deals when no one trusts you.
But when they taste how delicious this broth is, I'll win that trophy, and everyone will be coming to me to make a deal. You'll see.
Now, run along. Tell Ralph the trophy belongs to me. I think the bumbling oaf went <Lore>home</Lore>.
And I am SO very grateful, dearie. I'm a very busy woman, you know.
You are, are you? Then we should collaborate more often.
For me? You shouldn't have! And, oh, angelfish, you're just in time.
I told Ursula about the Do-Gooder Trophy, and she's real excited.
That's right. In fact, I want to make a special soup broth for the Valley. (Heh-heh-heh.)
Great! How can I help with that?
Your evil chuckle is VERY suspicious.
What's the scheme, Queen?
There's a good little guppy.
Ursula was just sayin' she collected some herbs in the <Lore>Glade of Trust</Lore>, but she lost 'em.
That's right. Would you <Lore>find my little Seaweed Sachet</Lore>, {PlayerName}? Of course, there are a few other things I'll need you to pick up and prepare, too...
Evil?
I'm sure I have no idea what you're talking about.
Queen? Oh, you do know how to flatter me.
